hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja kay apni qoam ko khabrdar kero , qabal iss kay kay unn per koi dardnak azab aa-khara ho .
. ( chunacheh ) unhon ney ( apni qoam say ) kaha kay :  aey meri qoam ! mein tumharay liye aik saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala hun
kay Allah ki ibadat kero , aur uss say daro , aur mera kehna maano ,

Allah tumharay gunahon ki maghfirat farmaye ga , aur tumhen aik muqarrar waqt tak baqi rakhay ga .   beyshak jab Allah ka muqarrar kiya huwa waqt aajata hai to phir woh moakhir nahi hota . kaash kay tum samajhtay hotay !
. ( phir ) nooh ney ( Allah taalaa say ) kaha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mein ney apni qoam ko raat din ( haq ki ) dawat di hai ,
lekin meri dawat ka iss kay siwa koi nateeja nahi huwa kay woh aur ziyada bhagney lagay .

aur mein ney jab bhi unhen dawat di , takay aap unn ki maghfirat farmayen , to unhon ney apni ungliyan apney kanon mein dey len , apney kapray apney oopper lapet liye , apni baat per array rahey , aur takabbur hi takabbur ka muzahira kertay rahey .
phir mein ney unhen pukar pukar ker dawat di ,
phir mein ney unn say aelania bhi baat ki , aur chupkay chupkay bhi samjhaya ,
chunacheh mein ney kaha kay : apney perwerdigar say maghfirat maango , yaqeen jano woh boht bakhshney wala hai ,
woh tum per aasman say khoob barishen barsaye ga ,
aur tumharay maal aur aulad mein taraqqi dey ga , aur tumharay liye baaghaat peda keray ga , aur tumhari khatir nehren mohaiyya kerday ga ,
tumhen kiya hogaya hai kay tum Allah ki azmat say bilkul nahi dartay-?
halankay uss ney tumhen takhleeq kay mukhtalif marhalon say guzaar ker peda kiya hai ,
kiya tum ney yeh nahi dekha kay Allah ney kiss tarah saat aasman oopper talay peda farmaye hain-?
aur unn mein chaand ko noor bana ker aur sooraj ko chiragh bana ker peda kiya hai ,
aur Allah ney tumhen zameen say behtareen tareeqay per ugaya hai ,
phir woh tumhen dobara ussi mein bhej dey ga , aur ( wahin say phir ) bahir nikal kharra keray ga .
aur Allah ney hi tumharay liye zameen ko aik farsh bana diya hai ,
takay tum uss kay khulay huye raaston per chalo .

nooh ney kaha :  aey meray perwerdigar ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn logon  ney mera kehna nahi maana , aur unn ( sardaron ) kay peechay chal parray jinn ko unn kay maal aur aulad ney nuqsan phonchaney kay siwa kuch nahi diya ,
aur unhon ney bari bhari makkaari say kaam liya hai ,
aur ( apney aadmiyon say ) kaha hai kay :  apney maboodon ko hergiz matt chorna . naa wadd aur sawaa ko kissi soorat mein chorna , aur naa yaghoos , yaooq aur nasar ko chorna .
iss tarah unhon ney boht son ko gumrah kerdiya hai , lehaza ( ya rab ! ) aap bhi inn ko gumrahi kay siwa kissi aur cheez mein taraqqi naa dijiye .
inn logon  kay gunahon ki wajeh hi say enhen gharq kiya gaya , phir aag mein dakhil kiya gaya , aur enhen Allah ko chorr ker koi himayati moyassar nahi aaye .
aur nooh ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! inn kafiron mein say koi aik bashinda bhi zameen per baqi naa rakhiye ,
agar aap inn ko baqi rakhen gay to yeh aap kay bandon ko gumrah keren gay , aur inn say jo aulad peda hogi woh bad-kaar aur paki kafir hi peda hogi .

meray perwerdigar ! meri bhi bakhshish farma dijiye , meray walaiden ki bhi , her uss shaks ki bhi jo meray ghar mein emaan ki halat mein dakhil huwa hai   aur tamam momin mardon aur momin aurton ki bhi . aur jo log zalim hain , unn ko tabahi kay siwa koi aur cheez ata naa farmaiye .
